observations.text: Fix scripts/generate_candidates.py: change 'from predict_tc import predict_tc' (line 17) to 'from scripts.predict_tc import predict_tc' to resolve ImportError since predict_tc lives in the scripts/ subdirectory.

Fix dft_calculator.py: replace calls to undefined run_scf() and run_phonon_calculation() in run_dft_pipeline() (lines 1062, 1075) with the existing run_full_dft_calculation() which already performs SCF + phonon + electron-phonon coupling in one call.

Fix run_pipeline.py: change importlib.import_module('query_database'), importlib.import_module('generate_candidates'), importlib.import_module('predict_tc') (lines 297-299) to use fully qualified names with 'scripts.' prefix (e.g., importlib.import_module('scripts.query_database')).

Fix streamlit_dashboard.py: remove orphaned 'elif tab == "System Health":' and 'elif tab == "Data Export":' blocks (lines 530-532) inside collaboration_hub_tab() that reference undefined variable 'tab' and will raise NameError on import.

Also (council-synthesis): Fix streamlit_dashboard.py: wrap module-level call to display_candidate_materials() (last line) inside 'if __name__ == "__main__":' gua

Add empty __init__.py to scripts/ directory to make it a proper Python package, enabling 'from scripts.predict_tc import predict_tc' imports used by run_pipelin — build command produced no file changes
